custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the weasel's white fur and the dark background/prop. AI models often struggle with high-contrast edges on fine fur. Verify if the 'wooden' object has a consistent grain direction or if it exhibits swirling/melting textures indicative of generative failure. Confirm that the visible paws have the correct number of digits and claw structure for a mustelid using high-resolution analysis, as pose estimators will miss this detail. Use the fine-grained classifier to check if the body proportions imply a missing tail, even if the tail itself is occluded.
